messages:
lucy: quick sync re: Orion pilot. They asked for 2-3 prioritized journeys, an eval plan (small but actionable), security answers for their vendor form, and a ballpark cost. Deadline: next Wed.

omar: hi all - my suggested journeys: 1) in-app help assistant (retrieval + short answers); 2) catalog search + rerank (ranking + explainability); 3) automated invoice redaction (PII scrub). Recommend prioritizing 1 then 2; 3 can be proof-of-concept with synthetic data.

lucy: agreed. Omar can you list minimal success criteria per journey? Keep it tight.

omar: sure: support assistant: 75% resolution rate on seed flows, p95 <350ms, citation presence >=90% when docs used. Catalog search: top-3 hit rate >=65% vs their baseline. Redaction: detect types (SSN, CC, DOB) with 99% recall on test set.

kevin: ops constraints from Orion: must support SAML, KMS for keys, and embeddings must not leave their VPC for regulated flows. They prefer Dedicated but ok with Hybrid (Dedicated + hosted fallback).

sara: security asks I'm tracking: data retention max 90 days, model logs for audit, revocation policy for keys, proof we don't train on their data. We'll need the standard vendor pack + network diagram.

lucy: legal-bot — any quick guidance on DPA/PII?

legal-bot: provide DPA template, note: if embeddings leave VPC require written approval. We can't promise no-training on customer data for hosted unless contractually excluded. Recommend Private for sensitive workloads.

kevin: good to know. Pricing: initial pilot (avg 3 rps, peak 12 rps) — recommend Dedicated small (1 GPU) + metered burst. Ballpark: $4.5k/mo + usage. If they require Private, add setup + infra SOW (~$30k one-time).

omar: endpoints proposal: POST /api/v1/help -> retrieval + generate; POST /api/v1/search -> rerank; POST /api/v1/redact -> PII detector. Each returns: status, tokens_generated_est, citations[], model_hash. Fallback policy: if Dedicated unavailable route to hosted lite model (only for non-sensitive flows).

kevin: add: health checks, rate-limit headers, and an error code when context contains disallowed PII.

omar: sample prompt (support):

```
System: "You are a concise help assistant. Use provided context to answer and cite sources with [doc:id]. If unsure, say 'I don't know' and don't hallucinate."
User: "{user_question}"
Context: "{top_3_chunks}"
```

lucy: nice. For evals we should keep scope small: 150 support prompts (mix of faq, edge cases, multi-step), 100 search queries for rerank, 50 redaction samples. Pass thresholds: support resolution >=75%, hallucination rate <5% (manual check), rerank top-3 >=65%, redaction recall 99%.

kevin: note on telemetry: we need per-token cost breakdown, token counts in logs, and ability to toggle quantized model variants for cost testing.

infra-bot: action created: infra-request-orion-2035002468 (raised by kevin).

lucy: timeline suggestion: Week A: infra + SSO + KMS stub, Week B: ingest seed docs + retrieval tuning, Week C: eval run + human review, Week D: canary and go/no-go. Total ~4 weeks to pilot.

omar: staffing: need 2 engs for Week A-B, 1 SME for Week C for manual evals. Confirm availability pls.

sara: I'll prepare the vendor pack and fill the parts we control. Need sample prompt exemplars — Omar can you provide 10 exemplars redacted?

omar: will add 10 exemplars, all redacted (<EMAIL>, <SSN> etc).

lucy: negotiation knobs for cost: 1) 12mo commit, 2) route non-critical queries to hosted lite, 3) quantize non-sensitive models. Include those in cost sheet.

kevin: one enterprise blocker flagged: their security team will ask about model provenance and our ability to provide model hashes and audit trail for inference. We can provide model_hash per response and deploy immutable model versions.

legal-bot: also they will ask about subcontractors and where logs are stored. Provide list of infra suppliers and retention locations.

lucy: ok next steps (concise): - kevin: draft cost comparo (hosted/dedicated/private + assumptions) by EOD tomorrow - omar: endpoints + 10 redacted prompt exemplars + eval skeleton by tomorrow AM - sara: vendor pack answers + diagrams in 48h - lucy: compile success criteria doc and DPA ask to legal.

kevin: confirmed. I'll include token assumptions (avg response tokens 120, embedding dims 1536 for their docs), and cost impact of quantization.

omar: one more ops note: ensure embeddings pipeline can be kept inside VPC for sensitive doc sets; indicate alternative of encrypted embeddings with customer KMS.

sara: noted. I'll mark items in the vendor form accordingly.

lucy: thanks team. I'll follow-up with a compact POC brief to Orion and attach our security pack. Reopen if anything urgent. :thumbsup:
